notes.title: New update with a very special Haunted Edition is now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.fatpanda.tv/SteamHeader.jpg[/img]

Update 1.0.5 - Haunted Edition ːsteamhappyː ːsteammockingː

Boo! Happy Halloween everybody! To celebrate this ghoulish holiday, Flat is now in his special Halloween costume! You’ll be able to play as this new spooky Flat for a limited time only! So what are you waiting for? Scare the bad guys and save the Flat Kingdom!

You’ll be able to use this costume until November 7th! After that, Flat will revert to his non-spooky self.  So don’t miss this chance to save the Flat Kingdom as a monster hero!

Here's the complete ChangeLog of this update:

### Changed
-Difficulty: Now enemies on the Noobie setting just do a quarter of a heart of damage, while the enemies from the Hero setting do half a heart. This will make the game a lot more forgiving and youíll be able to experiment and make mistakes.

### Fixed 
-Fixed some bugs in the Spanish language.
-We normalized some sounds that were too loud.
-We fixed some issues with the hitbox of some enemies in Flatepetl.
-We fixed the bug with the victory jingle.
-We Fixed a bug with the coins where they didn’t update if you left the stage when leaving a stage without using the pause menu.
-We Fixed a bug where Flat Forest appeared in the journal before you got there.
-We Fixed a bug with the squid’s sound.
-We Fixed a bug with the Quetzal, it still sounded even when you defeated him.

- Boo! Happy Halloween everybody! To celebrate this ghoulish holiday, Flat is now in his special Halloween costume! You’ll be able to play as this new spooky Flat for a limited time only! So what are you waiting for? Scare the bad guys and save the Flat Kingdom!

notes.title: 1.0.4 Update is out (Portuguese) + Reddit AMA tomorrow!
notes.content:
Hi dear players,
we have been monitorizing your comments on the forums and did some minor fixes in the game to fix your reported issues, thanks! This 1.0.4 update also adds the Portuguese language, so now many new players will be able to understand our game in their native language (we plan to keep adding new languages in future updates).

[h1]50% OFF DISCOUNT[/h1]

To celebrate 1.0.4 update and to thank you all for the continuous support to our work, [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/405970/]Flat Kingdom Paper's Cut Edition is 50% off during this whole week, also the Deluxe Edition bundle, that includes our OST by the incredible Manami Matsumae (Megaman, Shovel Knight) and the artbook, with over 100 pages.[/url][/b]

[h1]COME CHAT WITH US ON REDDIT ABOUT THE DEVELOPMENT OF FLAT KINGDOM[/h1]

Now that the game is out with Flat in its definitive form and we also polished the gameplay, we decided it was time to do a big recap of the 30 months of development behind it, so been working on a post-mortem article that is being posted on our [url=http://flatkingdom.tumblr.com/post/148010363923/the-important-part-of-this-story-began-last-april]devblog[/url]. We not only want to share our story with you, also will be live on Reddit doing an AMA by tomorrow afternoon (4.30 pm) on /r/pcgaming. You are all invited to meet us and have a chat about anything gamedev, indiedev and of course, Flat Kingdom related.

[url=http://gamesstarter.us13.list-manage1.com/subscribe?u=f1a3fc39e684a76d2251d3a7e&id=349bda1ae1]Sign in to our community newsletter if you want to be notified about the AMA few hours before it starts.[/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16107209/260a1888cc43f67388c246abb7a6653fe86ddf20.jpg[/img]

[h1]CHANGELOG:[/h1]

### Fixed 
-Fixed the bug that moved the player to the right with the Xbox One controller in Windows 10.
-Fixed some images that were in bad resolution.
-Fixed the bug with the “Capitalist Dog” achievement.
-Fixed the possum bug in Flatforest Part 1.

### Added 
-Added full localization to Portuguese.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16107209/c699f5b81f7d12ea2aeeaf0f654f69b150c5069a.jpg[/img]

We really hope you enjoy this update and please if you find anything can be improved, let us know, we'll keep listening to you as we've done in the past.

Cheers!
Games Starter and Fat Panda Games.

notes.title: Paper's Cut Edition is out now at 50% off during all Steam Summer Sale.
notes.content:
After collecting tons of feedback from the community and a month and a half of hard work, the so much anticipated Paper's Cut Edition is already out and ready to purchase at 50% off during the whole Steam Summer Sale:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16107209/c699f5b81f7d12ea2aeeaf0f654f69b150c5069a.jpg[/img]

As we mentioned in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/405970/announcements/detail/820034025734003745]previous posts this last week[/url], in this latest version of the game you can find numerous fixes and improvements upon the previous one, the more relevant being the ones related to the main character redesign and animations, more responsive controls, localization to Russian and German, new introduction and better accessibiltiy in general.

Our friends at Orange Bison played the update yesterday and got their review revisited, giving it a 10 out of 10:  

http://orangebison.com/flat-kingdom/review/

"I couldn't find fault! You fixed all the issues, listened to your fans and produced something that made me feel like a 10 year old again. Seriously well done." -Andrew McMaster.


We really hope you enjoy this update and please if you find anything can be improved, let us know, we'll keep listening to you as we've done in the past.

Cheers!
Games Starter and Fat Panda Games.

notes.title: Want to participate in our Paper's Cut Edition closed beta?
notes.content:
Hi folks!

we have only a couple days until Paper's Cut Edition goes public! So after several successful tests with some fans and friends during the past weekend, we decided it's a good time to let you try it out! we invite you all to take part in the Flat Kingdom Paper's Cut Edition closed beta stage. It will last only a few days, and your feedback about it will be really valuable for us!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16107209/c699f5b81f7d12ea2aeeaf0f654f69b150c5069a.jpg[/img]

Will explain you how to access the update:

The most important point we are testing with this closed beta stage is that the old saves don't get lost/overwritten with the new 1.0.3 update, because Fat Panda found the way to keep using them after the update and continue playing your savegame without the need to start all over! 

So to test this is working well without taking any risk, first thing I recommend you is to backup your savegames, they are located under: C:/users/youruser/AppData/LocalLow/Fat Panda.

Once you have a copy of your saves in a safe place, go to your Steam Library, select Flat Kingdom and go to Properties in the contextual menu of the game, then go to the Betas tab and finally activate it using the password "PapersCut2016". 

That's all, at this point the game should be updating to 1.0.3 and you should be able to continue playing from your latest savepoint (if you've already beaten the tutorial in previous versions), or start over from the very beginning of the game and enjoy all the new cutscenes and tutorial we've added.

Please contact us at support@gamesstarter.com or comment here if you have any issue so we can address it as soon as possible (in that case please specify your OS, gamepad/keyboard model, etc).

This update is really important to us, as we want to address some key issues with the game (you can find the full list below). We hope you like it, and if you find we did a good job, please consider reviewing the game on Steam. That will help us to be more relevant among the myriad of platformers that are on Steam, causing other players to find Flat Kingdom, especially during the upcoming weeks that's the Steam Summer Sale.

[h1]Paper's Cut Edition / V1.0.3 CHANGELOG:[/h1]

[b]### Added[/b]
[list]
    [*]New and improved animations for expressions and special moves of Flat (i.e. stomp).
    [*]Flat is now more agile, specially when jumping and gliding (faster stomping/super stomping, he can jump even when he’s trapped in a corner, Glide doesn't get interrupted when Flat collides with a wall). 
    [*]Added full localization to Russian and German.
    [*]New intro-tutorial sequences explaining in more detail about Flat past and each character's role.
    [*]Improved combat tutorial, more progressive and clear.
    [*]New and improved FX sounds (run, steps, mischievous plant, switching shapes, gameover, steps).
    [*]Added Logitech F310 gamepad support.
    [*]We added signals indicating deathly pits.
    [*]The game displays the number of collected coins on the upper right corner of the screen when Flat is close to a merchant.
    [*]Added gamepad and keyboard button/key remapping option.
    [*]We added a combat guide in the UI that often reminds you the relationships between the shapes and which one beats the other (this hint can be disabled at your choice).
    [*]Now you can check in the world map how many scrolls are left in each world, this will be a great help for those of you trying to get to 100%!
[/list]

[b]### Changed[/b]
[list]
    [*]New character design for Flat, adding brand new switching shape effects.
    [*]Camera follows Flat at the same speed when running.
    [*]Selecting the Continue option from the main menu now spawns you on the last checkpoint you activated (within a level) instead of the world map. 
    [*]Some enemies designs have been improved: Roundowls, stonesnails and grumpeels.
[/list]

[b]### Fixed[/b]
    [list][*]Fixed small bugs in bosses: Quetzal, Fenrir, Kraken.[/list]

Thanks a lot for your support.
Games Starter and Fat Panda Games.

notes.title: New Paper’s Cut Edition (1.0.3 Update) and early players rewards.
notes.content:
Hi everybody, 

It’s been a while since the last update, but that only means that the upcoming 1.0.3 version of Flat Kingdom will contain quite a lot of improvements and fixes, so many that we decided to rebrand the whole game as Paper’s Cut Edition, due to launch on next 22nd of June. We collected the feedback from players and industry professionals and did our best to come up with as many improvements as we could add during the last month and a half. That’s a tight schedule, especially when you compare it to the 27 months of development time behind of the whole project, Fat Panda Games has been dedicated to improve all the aspects in the game, from narrative to visuals, gameplay, some enemies’ design, we’ve localised the game to Russian and German (thanks to Evgenia Tarasova and Marcel Weyers) and even improved several sounds and added new ones (thanks to Yoho Arsenal). 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16107209/f26a6b8c4d9b89cfea0c73056e2a537dcc8683f8.png[/img]

The most relevant and visible change in this update relies on the main character of the game. We know it’s not normal to redesign main characters, but after talking to players and game developers from our community, we discovered that Flat needed an evolution to improve its consistency and personality into one that fits better with the narrative context and aesthetics of Flat Kingdom. Now we really feel this is the Flat that really belongs to our world. Hope you like it too. We’ll publish an article during the upcoming weeks with an analysis about the whole creative process behind this unusual, but necessary, change.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16107209/a3adcc2b9bfc08a89854ccaeb9e9bafda21ada2d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16107209/0d113af055fd0edaa8f8ca46ab1ddae724e3141a.jpg[/img]

[h1]1.0.3 CHANGELOG:[/h1]

[b]### Added[/b]
[list]
    [*]New and improved animations for expressions and special moves of Flat (i.e. stomp).
    [*]Flat is now more agile, specially when jumping and gliding (faster stomping/super stomping, he can jump even when he’s trapped in a corner, Glide doesn't get interrupted when Flat collides with a wall). 
    [*]Added full localization to Russian and German.
    [*]New intro-tutorial sequences explaining in more detail about Flat past and each character's role.
    [*]Improved combat tutorial, more progressive and clear.
    [*]New and improved FX sounds (run, steps, mischievous plant, switching shapes, gameover, steps).
    [*]Added Logitech F310 gamepad support.
    [*]We added signals indicating deathly pits.
    [*]The game displays the number of collected coins on the upper right corner of the screen when Flat is close to a merchant.
    [*]Added gamepad and keyboard button/key remapping option.
    [*]We added a combat guide in the UI that often reminds you the relationships between the shapes and which one beats the other (this hint can be disabled at your choice).
    [*]Now you can check in the world map how many scrolls are left in each world, this will be a great help for those of you trying to get to 100%!
[/list]

[b]### Changed[/b]
[list]
    [*]New character design for Flat, adding brand new switching shape effects.
    [*]Camera follows Flat at the same speed when running.
    [*]Selecting the Continue option from the main menu now spawns you on the last checkpoint you activated (within a level) instead of the world map. 
    [*]Some enemies designs have been improved: Roundowls, stonesnails and grumpeels.
[/list]

[b]### Fixed[/b]
    [list][*]Fixed small bugs in bosses: Quetzal, Fenrir, Kraken.[/list]

[h1]DRAWBACKS AND REWARDS/ COMPENSATION FOR ALL PRE-1.0.3 PLAYERS.[/h1]

[h1]UPDATE.[/h1]
We have managed to keep your old saves, so after updating you will be able to continue playing from the point you were at before. The only requirement you need to keep playing your old save is to have finished the tutorial in the previous versions of the game. Nevertheless we recommend you to start over in order to enjoy all the new cutscenes and the new tutorial we've added in Paper's Cut Edition.

[b]OLD POST[/b]
Sadly not all the consequences from updating to 1.0.3 will be good. We’ve been doing some very significant changes to the game that have impacted on the savegame format, meaning that the already stored savegames from previous versions of the game won’t be compatible with 1.0.3 and this update will overwrite the save game files. We have been researching possible ways to convert those saves to the new version without success for now, this is a very complex task that will keep working on during the week we have until release. Cannot guarantee anything else than our best effort to keep/convert your saves (know that in any case your Steam achievements won’t be affected by the update). To compensate this damage, we’re going to giveaway a free game and a DLC code (includes the artbook and soundtrack) to each of you who already have Flat Kingdom and also have some progress in the game. If you are one of the affected players, please register on our [url=http://gamesstarter.us13.list-manage1.com/subscribe?u=f1a3fc39e684a76d2251d3a7e&id=349bda1ae1]mailing list[/url] and we’ll get in touch with you through email and Steam to verify your purchase and also send you the codes.

Thanks for your understanding and support so far to Flat Kingdom!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16107209/56144d817d75c20417680519f65b5e119fceec92.gif[/img]

Best Regards,
Fat Panda Games and Games Starter. 

PS: If you are one of the few players who is very advanced in the game and want to get your 100% before the 1.0.3 update comes up. Talk to us and we’ll give you a hand, write to support@gamesstarter.com.

notes.title: Flat Kingdom 1.0.2 - New Update Available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
based on your super valuable feedback, in this new update we have tweaked several things related to the game design. The most common report was that the game could be a little too hard or frustrating (especially when fighting bosses) so we tweaked it to make the fights more fair.

For those of you who enjoyed the original challenge, we kept it on Hard Mode. Now you can play on that difficulty from the beginning without the need to unlock it, so give it a try if you’re feeling brave!

Here’s the complete change log:

## [1.0.2] - 2016-04-15
### Improved
[list]
[*]The first boss weakness is now more evident.
[*]Improved scenery for some worlds.
[*]Flat is now much faster when underwater.
[*]Flat can now damage enemies and collect stuff during his invincibility frames.
[/list]

### Added
[list]
[*]Life meters for bosses.
[*]11 new checkpoints scattered all over the game.
[/list]

### Changed
[list]
[*]Boss fights are now more fair. They expose their weakness more often, so should not be so hard anymore.
[*]The objective in the norns boss fight now is clearer on Easy and Normal modes. 
[*]Pushable objects now all have the same texture (to make clearer what you can push and what you can’t)
[*]Hard mode is now unlocked from the beginning (for those who enjoy the challenge)
[*]Beating the game on Normal or Hard also unlocks the achievements for lower difficulties.
[/list]

### Fixed
[list]
[*]Shapeshifter achievement fixed (This time is for real).
[*]Enemy collisions are improved, they’re more fair now.
[*]Hank boss fight have improved projectile detection.
[*]Hank boss fight has now a better death cinematic.
[*]Enemies can’t push Flat around that easily anymore.
[*]Some enemy attacks now are shorter.
[*]Most blind jumps and leaps of faith are fixed.
[/list]

If you want to meet us, learn more about the inspirations and and win some copies of Flat Kingdom, join our livestream tomorrow at 17:00h at  [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC_qh2NCfR_wFUeTd5DBOOjA]Games Starter's Youtube channel[/url]
If you are interested in following the news about Flat Kingdom, check out the following links:

[list]
[*][b]Official website[/b]: http://flatkingdom.com/
[*][b]Facebook[/b]: https://www.facebook.com/flatkingdom
[*][b]Twitter[/b]: https://twitter.com/FlatKingdom
[*][b]Tumblr[/b]: http://flatkingdom.tumblr.com/
[/list]

Let us know if you have more issues!

Best Regards,
Games Starter & Fat Panda Games.

notes.title: Flat Kingdom 1.0.1 is now released! (+ FREE Early Supporters Art Book)
notes.content:
Hi! 
Are you playing Flat Kingdom? What do you think? We hope you are having fun. We’re listening all your feedback and improving the game as much as we can, so feel free to share your opinions no our forums!

In this update you will find (among your local files) our [b]Early Supporters Artbook![/b] ([url=http://www.slideshare.net/GamesStarter/flat-kingdom-early-supporters-artbook]online version here[/url]). A present from us to all the Flat Kingdom community, especially dedicated to our early supporters (if you backed us on IndieGoGo, Kickstarter or ThunderClap, you will find your name on the first pages!). Learn more details about the development of the game, the characters, the Kingdom and other topics. 

[b]Here’s the complete ChangeLog:[/b]

## [1.0.1] - 2016-04-09
### Added
-We added the early supporter’s art book (You can find it on your local files now).
-We added a change log file!

### Changed
-Collisions are now disabled when the character dies, to avoid a double KO when fighting enemies (some bosses had issues with this)

### Fixed
-Shapeshifter achievement is now fixed.
-Kraken’s tentacles have improved damage detection. Now you can damage them right after changing shapes in a very close distance.

[b]User review reminder:[/b]
We want to remind you it would help us a lot if you write a review of the game, that way other players will have a better idea and Steam will see you care about our game, so their system will give us more visibility.

Thanks for all your feedback! Help us keep improving!

If you are interested in following the news about Flat Kingdom, check out the following links:
